summary: Keep mapping: response rates will be well below average, so the list needs to get well into triple figures. Biggest gaps for £100m+ Grade A work: Multiplex, Bovis (Lendlease UK, sold to Atlas Holdings), BAM Construct UK, Ardmore, Canary Wharf Contractors. Strong second tier: Galliford Try, Gilbert-Ash, Winvic (moving into data centres), Heron Bros (active in data centres), Farrans, Tilbury Douglas, Henry. Mine ISG alumni (ISG collapsed in 2024). Large firms with very few current people mapped: Balfour Beatty, Laing O'Rourke, Kier, Sir Robert McAlpine, Willmott Dixon, Wates, Morgan Sindall, VINCI Building UK, Sisk; thin M&E: NG Bailey, Mercury, Kirby, Jones Engineering, Equans. Mace and Skanska look covered about right. Check for duplicate company records in Clockwork.
